verdict.rationale: Manufact documents a REST API (via API keys) and a testing dashboard that runs test suites across MCP clients/models, but there is no evidence of an interactive API reference with runnable examples (e.g., a Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) — a direct probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s.
